readme: Per-physical-device display name overrides template. Copy this file to devices.json next to Voltide.exe (optional: without devices.json, every device keeps its provider's generic name). Matching rule: vid and pid (4-digit hex) must match, and either containerId (preferred) or instance must match the target physical device. Values can be inspected via: Voltide-Test.exe --test (or --test --json). Valid kind values: Mouse, Keyboard, Headset, Other.

overrides.comment: Example entry (fictional IDs). Replace vid, pid, containerId/instance, and display fields with your own device values.
overrides.name: Example Wireless Keyboard
